# GO enrichment of modules

The maintained entry point is `run_module_enrichment()`. Advanced users should
call it directly from R code with explicit arguments:

```{r}
go_result <- run_module_enrichment(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  network_type = network_type,
  modules = modules,
  database = "GO",
  ontology = "BP"
)

kegg_result <- run_module_enrichment(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  network_type = network_type,
  modules = modules,
  database = "KEGG"
)
```

The returned reports contain the selected parameters, result tables, plot
objects, mapping diagnostics, and saved artifact paths:

```{r}
go_result$results
kegg_result$results
```
